scripts.setup:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && npm run prisma:generate && npm run prisma:push && npm run seed && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run prisma:generate && npx prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && npm run build
scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && npm run prisma:generate
